name: Maia Mechanics Pro Web Widget
author: maiamechanicsonline

sections.description:
A fully customizable, embeddable chart calculator powered by Maia Mechanics.

Allow your visitors to generate their own charts — including Connection and Just Now charts — while you control the look, layout, and language to match your brand. With features like live style preview, optional email collection, and CRM integration, it’s the simplest way to offer accurate chart generation directly on your site. Just install, customize, and activate with a subscription — no coding required.

Just install, customize, and activate with a subscription — no coding required.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the wordpress repository.
  2. Add your API Key in the plugin’s settings screen

  3. Place the shortcode anywhere in the website

    [mmi_pro_web_widget]
